error.title: Missing sound clip file(s)
error.description:
## Sound clip file(s) not found
The scene references {missing_count} sound clip file(s) that cannot be located on disk:
{missing_files_list}
### Why this matters
When the render job runs on the Deadline farm worker, TVPaint will load this scene in a headless process. The native TVPaint dialog "Missing sound dependencies: Alternative Paths" will appear when it tries to load these missing sound files. Since there is no operator to interact with the dialog, the Deadline worker will hang indefinitely, and the job will eventually timeout without producing any renders.
### How to repair
You have four options:
1. **Delete all missing sound clips**: Right-click this validation error and use the **Delete Missing Sound Clips** action to automatically remove every sound clip whose audio file cannot be found.
2. **Relink the audio file**: In TVPaint's Sound panel, right-click the broken sound clip and relink it to the correct audio file location.
3. **Update the file path**: If the audio file was moved, restore it to the original location, or relink all sound clips to their new locations.
4. **Remove the sound clip**: If the audio is no longer needed, delete the sound clip from the Sound panel before re-publishing.
After making any changes, save the workfile and publish again.
